block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.system: Cornerstone C11 Engine Block 3 Body Specialization
block_1_metadata.role: Canonical Template Schema for Composable Business Logic, .h/.c Parity, Telemetry & Reconstructible Docs
invariants: Strict ISO C11 adherence (-std=c11, -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic) and C++ header compatibility
Dual Audience Documentation Covenant (Covenant 17) + Reconstruct-from-Source (.c) Contract
Block 3 houses composable non-lifecycle cogs only: macros stay in 2.4, static helpers in 2.5, audits in 4, procedures in 5.1, lifecycle in 5.2
Block 3 emits recursion-guarded telemetry and validation probes so engine behavior is observable under fault and Safe-Mode paths

block_3_body.facade_umbrella_statutory_text: all functional APIs are declared in their respective domain headers
block_3_body.zero_duplication_parser_rule: Primary modules reuse *_fallback shared JSON schema parsers cleanly without raw boundary-blind strstr() scanning or silent clamping workarounds.
block_3_body.header_and_source_doc_parity: Assume headers were magically deleted and must be regenerated from .c alone: paired .h and .c share identical Sub-Assembly 3.1..3.N structure and symbol placement, and every public cog in both .h and .c carries complete Dual-Audience, @param, @return, and @triggers Doxygen (without copying prose verbatim) plus step-by-step internal why comments in .c.
block_3_body.block_3_logging_and_debugging_contract: Block 3 operations must provide live observability via reentrancy- and preflight-guarded telemetry (*_EMIT_LOG / LOG_SET_TRIPWIRE / io_fallback_record_fault / debug_fallback_record_fault) and trigger Block 4 probes via debug_trigger_probe() on corrupt payloads, bounds overflows, path traversal rejections, rewind checksum tampering, and Safe-Mode downgrades.
block_3_body.shim_retirement_policy: Legacy wrappers retained solely for unmodernized strata (e.g. debug_trap_tripwire while core/ migrates) must be flagged @deprecated with replacement target (debug_trigger_probe) and purged once callers migrate.

dual_audience_balance_guidelines.For Game Designers & Non-Programmers: Plain-English purpose, editable JSON config keys for modders/players, gameplay/UX impact, and Safe-Mode behavior.
dual_audience_balance_guidelines.For Systems Programmers & Engine Archite: Header = caller contract, complexity, zero-heap guarantee, failure returns; Source = exact stack scratch frames, .bss/.rodata chassis writes, lockouts, delegation helpers, and @triggers probes.
